prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: a storm claim with no photos of the damage. What experienced assessors have found: Assessors keep accepting the Met Office storm record for the postcode plus a roofer's invoice in place of photos, and settle within authority.
